verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is an API-first product. Its public documentation covers the HTML API's key and URL parameters plus many endpoints, including Google Search, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, ChatGPT, Gemini and Usage. LLM-oriented docs are served at llms.txt, and the probe confirms that index returns HTTP 200. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of the API docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
